## Safety review

- [ ] No secrets or private environment details are included.
- [ ] Research, replay, paper, shadow, and testnet boundaries remain explicit.
- [ ] Dangerous actions retain authorization, typed confirmation, kill-switch, and audit behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Money, price, balance, notional, and PnL values still use decimal types.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior or the PR explains why not.
- [ ] Documentation claims match the implementation.
